part1.title: Part 1 · Match nodes in static drawings
part1.instruction: The four highlighted nodes on the left form a path. Select the same four nodes in the drawing on the right, shown at a different aspect ratio.

part3.title: Compare two animations
part3.instruction: Watch two DARCOL animations of the same graph with identical starting and final drawings, then rate which animation you prefer overall. One interpolates precomputed intermediate layouts with movement highlights; the other interpolates directly between the endpoints.

questions.text: Which animation do you prefer overall?
